script = '''
import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
from markitdown import MarkItDown
import io
import sys

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"

# --- Part 1: Extract text using MarkItDown ---
print("=" * 60)
print("PART 1: TEXT EXTRACTION (MarkItDown)")
print("=" * 60)
try:
    md = MarkItDown()
    result = md.convert(pdf_path)
    text_content = result.text_content
    # Print first 3000 chars to avoid flooding
    if len(text_content) > 3000:
        print(text_content[:3000])
        print(f"\\n... [truncated, total {len(text_content)} characters]")
    else:
        print(text_content)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"MarkItDown extraction error: {e}")

# --- Part 2: OCR on the first page image ---
print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("PART 2: OCR ON FIRST PAGE IMAGE (Tesseract)")
print("=" * 60)
try:
    doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)
    page = doc[0]
    # Render at 300 DPI for good OCR quality
    mat = fitz.Matrix(300/72, 300/72)
    pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
    img_data = pix.tobytes("png")
    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_data))
    # Save the first page image
    img.save("output/handbook_page1.png")
    print(f"First page rendered: {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} pixels, saved to output/handbook_page1.png")
    # Run OCR
    ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
    if len(ocr_text) > 3000:
        print(ocr_text[:3000])
        print(f"\\n... [truncated, total {len(ocr_text)} characters]")
    else:
        print(ocr_text)
    doc.close()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"OCR error: {e}")
'''
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
